neighbours.label: word-final pieces of '-atical/-atically' words and 'orphan', plus 'physically' (grammatically, mathematical, orphaned)
fire: There is nothing grammatically wrong with that sentence, but it sounds odd.
The puzzle requires only basic mathematical reasoning to solve.
Several child processes were orphaned when the server crashed.
He was too exhausted to physically climb the last flight of stairs.
The charity runs a shelter for orphaned elephants in Kenya.
The teacher explained the grammatical difference between the two verbs.
She was physically unable to lift the heavy box onto the shelf.
Her proof was mathematically elegant and only one page long.
quiet: There is nothing really wrong with that sentence, but it sounds odd.
The puzzle requires only basic logical reasoning to solve.
Several child processes were stopped when the server crashed.
He was too exhausted to even climb the last flight of stairs.
The charity runs a shelter for injured elephants in Kenya.
The teacher explained the subtle difference between the two verbs.
She was simply unable to lift the heavy box onto the shelf.
Her proof was remarkably elegant and only one page long.

notes: Top tokens 'atical' x8, ' physically' x5, ' orphan' x4, ' original' x4, 'phan' x3, 'atically' x2. A list, not a distinction; tested as tokens.
